name: The Third Stone
description: The one hearth on the dark road, kept by Returners and not by the order. A walled rest with a pit lamp on a driven stake out front and never a lamp post, a mine cart and a lean ladder in the yard, a chest of oil jars, a wayshrine the order did not bless, and two dark pit lamps on the approach. Eskil keeps it; Aske's Red Company crew keeps the yard and walks the dark miles, paid for.

signs.title: THIS LAMP IS NOT ON THE ROLLS.
